DEO Welding Fabrication LLC

54 Years of Experience.

Built on experience. Finished with precision.

With 54 years of experience working with ferrous metals, DEO Welding Fabrication LLC brings decades of craftsmanship, fabrication knowledge and dependable workmanship to every project.

We specialize in custom fabrication, structural metalwork, repairs and replacement. Whether you need a new build or an existing piece repaired, we are ready to get the job done.
